description: The bar chart titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks” illustrates benchmark scores for two models across multiple academic and practical datasets/metrics. The horizontal axis contains the categorical benchmarks (left to right): GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, with labels angled diagonally; the axis is labeled “Dataset and Metrics” and does not indicate a special sorting beyond this displayed order. The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Score (%)” on a linear scale, spanning roughly 0 to 80 with evenly spaced tick marks at 10-point intervals. Each category shows a pair of side-by-side bars: a blue bar for “LLaMA-3-8B-it” and an orange bar for “Ours (Iterative RLHF),” as indicated by the legend titled “Model” in the upper right. Approximate bar heights are: GSM-8K ~80 (blue) and ~80 (orange); MMLU ~66 (blue) and ~65 (orange); HumanEval ~61 (blue) and ~64 (orange); TruthfulQA shows only an orange bar at ~60 with no visible blue bar; ARC ~59 (blue) and ~64 (orange); MBPP ~61 (blue) and ~60 (orange); LC AlpacaEval-2 ~23 (blue) and ~31 (orange); MT-Bench (×5) ~41 (blue) and ~42 (orange); Chat-Arena-Hard ~20 (blue) and ~29 (orange). No bars appear stacked, and there are no visible annotations, outlines, or other emphasis beyond the consistent color coding and grouped arrangement.
caption_used: The bar chart titled 'Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks' compares the performance of two models, LLaMA-3-8B-it and Ours (Iterative RLHF), across nine datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis is labeled 'Dataset and Metrics,' with categories including GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents 'Score (%)' on a linear scale from 0 to 80, marked at intervals of 10%. Both models perform similarly on GSM-8K, achieving scores of approximately 80%. On MMLU, LLaMA-3-8B-it slightly outperforms Ours (Iterative RLHF) with a score of 70% compared to 65%. For HumanEval, Ours (Iterative RLHF) shows a notable improvement, scoring 70% compared to LLaMA-3-8B-it's 60%. TruthfulQA demonstrates a consistent upward trend for both models, with Ours (Iterative RLHF) reaching 65% and LLaMA-3-8B-it trailing at 45%. ARC and MBPP show identical performance for both models at 60%. LC AlpacaEval-2 and MT-Bench (×5) exhibit modest scores, with Ours (Iterative RLHF) slightly outperforming LLaMA-3-8B-it. Chat-Arena-Hard shows the lowest scores, with both models performing below 30%. Overall, Ours (Iterative RLHF) consistently outperforms LLaMA-3-8B-it across most benchmarks, particularly in HumanEval and TruthfulQA, demonstrating its superior generalization capabilities.
